item.title: Iran continues strikes across the Persian Gulf despite Trump's warning
item.summary: Iran continued to target Gulf countries with ballistic missiles and drones Thursday as the U.S. Embassy in Baghdad issued a security alert warning of attacks by Iran-backed militias.

item.title: U.S. lifts sanctions on Venezuela's acting President Delcy Rodríguez
item.summary: The newly announced sanctions relief is the latest U.S. recognition of Rodríguez as a legitimate authority in Venezuela ever since the U.S. military captured her predecessor, Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: Trump's VA killed a home loan program. Vets are now losing their homes because of it
item.summary: Foreclosures on VA loans are at their highest level in a decade. VA has a fix but it is months away and could still leave vets worse off than most other homeowners.

item.title: Appeals court rejects HUD homelessness overhaul saying it would be "disastrous"
item.summary: The federal housing agency wants to shift money away from permanent housing and toward programs that impose sobriety and other conditions. Advocates warn that would push many back into homelessness.

item.title: Republicans in Congress say they have a deal to end the record-long shutdown at DHS
item.summary: The plan would fund DHS, except for immigration enforcement, through September. Republicans would then try to fund the whole agency for three years using a tactic that would not need Democratic votes.

item.title: Have Trump's tariffs worked? This is where things stand a year after 'Liberation Day'
item.summary: It has been a year since President Trump announced double-digit tariffs on imports from around the world. So far, those levies have not produced the economic boom the president promised.

item.title: In a thunderous launch, Artemis II astronauts leave Earth. Here's what's next
item.summary: NASA's Artemis II crew has successfully launched on a mission that will take it around the moon and back to Earth. Here's what to expect over their roughly 10-day journey.

item.title: FIFA hikes World Cup prices, again. A finals ticket can now cost as much as $11,000
item.summary: FIFA has raised prices for over 40 games of the World Cup in its latest sale that kicked off Wednesday, according to an NPR count. The most expensive tickets to the final now cost $10,900.

item.title: The FDA approves a new obesity pill, giving patients another option
item.summary: The daily pill called Foundayo got a fast track through the Food and Drug Administration. It will compete with the pill form of Wegovy as an alternative to obesity drugs given by injection.

item.title: As hoops betting spikes, it's New Hampshire and other states vs. prediction markets
item.summary: In New Hampshire and states with legalized sports gambling, wagering helps fund government services. But now competitors like Kalshi and Polymarket are getting a cut of the action.
